implement_updater_subclass: create a subclass of Updater that implements the abstract update method for PPO training
call_update_method: call the update method on an Updater instance with a Storage rollout object to perform a policy update
access_lr_scheduler: access the lr_scheduler property on an Updater instance to retrieve the learning rate scheduler
call_after_update: call the after_update method on an Updater instance to run post-update hooks after a policy update
resume_optimizer_state: call get_resume_state and load_state_dict on an Updater to save and restore optimizer state
